metadata.source: Wikipedia: Margaret W. Rossiter History of Women in Science Prize recipients
metadata.notes: The prize honours a book in odd-numbered years and an article in even-numbered years; only the book years are imported. Book rows are identified by an italic marker anchored at the very start of the Work cell — article rows also contain italics, but only for the container volume or journal. The importer throws if the anchored-italics signal and the odd-year rule ever disagree. The official HSS archive blocks automated fetching (HTTP 403), so the cited Wikipedia table is used. Official archive: https://hssonline.org/page/rossiter
metadata.coverageNotes: Winner-only. Even-year article awards are intentionally excluded.
